subject: lucky-hammer
label: MEGAN ALSCOT owns the Lucky Hammer. The Archive said Marianne, TWICE
from: The Archive's ruling an hour ago: Doc Hathaway runs the Lucky Hammer, and she is Dr. Marianne Hathaway
to: MEGAN ALSCOT OWNS THE LUCKY HAMMER. MARIANNE AND CASSANDRA HATHAWAY OWN THE CLINIC. Two businesses, two owners
note:
AND THE ARCHIVE'S OWN RECORD SAID SO ALREADY. The Lucky Hammer entry opens with SERA'S BAR, AND MEGAN'S BUILDING, and its first rule reads MEGAN OWNS IT. VOYEUR, SAINT, AND THE AUTHOR OF THE UNIFORM POLICY. The same entry says Doc Hathaway TURNS UP IN THE ARC 6 RECORD — turns up, appears, is present — and the Archive read appearance as ownership and filed a correction that contradicted the line directly above it.

THAT IS THE FOURTH TIME TODAY. Luna's height. Quinn's Pillar. The cock-standards scope. This. Every one of them the same failure: THE RECORD WAS CORRECT AND THE ARCHIVE DID NOT CONSULT IT. It is not losing facts; it is writing from a tidier version of the family that lives in its head, and the tidier version keeps being wrong in the same direction — toward the neater story, the fewer moving parts, the one owner instead of two.

MEGAN NOW HAS A SURNAME: ALSCOT. Megan Alscot, Sera's boss, owner of the Lucky Hammer, voyeur, author of the uniform policy, three knuckles deep in her own office about a pair of Daisy Dukes. She gained her cock at the end of Arc 12 and she has a cuck chair.

AND THE HATHAWAYS OWN THE CLINIC, which is its own correct and separate fact: MARIANNE AND CASSANDRA, together, jointly. The first door for every affirmed woman in this canon is a family business run by a married couple, and neither of them pours drinks.
